cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says a law, decree or policy in force classifies government data or requires it to be held in the country; the national data centre (GIN-001, GIN-002) does not answer that.
cells.note: Reassessed under Bill's ruling of 2026-10-31 (every lower rung shown by its own evidence): the AI roadmap validated in December 2025 proposes a national sovereign cloud for state data (GIN-003), so stage 2. The national data centre opened in September 2025 holds the state's strategic data (GIN-001, GIN-002), but no rule on state data is in force, so hosting no longer lifts the cell to 4.
